_comment: Per-machine configuration for deadreckon-count.
Commit one of these per machine in the repo root.
machine.folder   must match an entry in machines.json
machine.label    human-readable name shown in reports
daemon.sync_interval_hours    how often Job 1 (repo sync) runs
daemon.ledger_interval_hours  how often Job 2 (lifetime ledger) runs
daemon.started                set automatically when daemon first starts
extra_paths  additional absolute paths to search for CLI data.
Use this for external drives, non-standard installs, or
profiles copied to ~/Documents etc. The system discovers
standard locations automatically; this is supplemental.
cli_overrides  per-CLI customisation. Only needed when a tool was
installed in a non-standard location or uses different
field names. The system works without any overrides.
To add a new CLI, append a block here — no Python needed.
cli_overrides fields:
cli           identifier used in reports (must be unique)
label         human-readable name
paths         home-relative paths to search (supplements auto-discovery)
token_fields  which JSON fields hold token counts
walk_depth    how many levels deep to search (default: 4)

cli_overrides._comment: Example: uncomment and fill in to add a CLI not built into sessions.py.
cli_overrides.label: My New CLI
